verdict.rationale: Fireworks' docs repeatedly state it provides an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and APIs, and position it as a drop-in replacement where you point your client at api.fireworks.ai. A Create Chat Completion endpoint is documented, and tool calling uses OpenAI-compatible tool specifications. Together these let an agent swap to or from Fireworks without provider-specific code; extensions like service_tier and x-session-affinity are optional. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that switching works without code changes, and documentation of any OpenAI parameters or behaviors that are unsupported or differ.
